scope: Two opposite shaft-attached brightness hotspots sampled from a full-circle map at each blade angle, with a per-client accepted-frame movement limit on desktop and phone.

appearance.evenAndOdd: A continuous 360-degree map is sampled per blade. Odd blade counts may place a hotspot between neighboring blades; the represented count is unchanged.
appearance.invariants: Each blade retains its own brightness, hue, opacity, size, and radius during motion.
appearance.draw: One fullscreen triangle, 48 bytes of frame uniforms, no per-blade CPU loop or DOM nodes.

limit.formulaAtSteadyNormalSimulationSpeed: min(requested rev/s, accepted drawn FPS * maxPatternStep / 2)
limit.reference: Unwrapped full-scale phase; same reduction preserves fractional RPM response and N1/N2 proportions.
limit.stalls: Apply after the draw-rate gate; discard excess requested rotation with no later catch-up. Forced resize/backend redraws keep the displayed phase and do not consume pending motion.

checks.note: Final CI also linted the corrected GPU checker.

checks.command: npx vitest related --run src/flight/hud/engineSpoolMotion.ts src/flight/hud/engineSpoolRenderer.ts src/flight/hud/engineSummary.ts src/flight/hud/engineMonitor.ts src/flight/settings/flightParameters.ts src/remote/PhoneEngine.tsx src/remote/protocol.ts --maxWorkers=50%

gpu.visualReview: Native 68 CSS px preview inspected; two opposite brightness regions are visible with even and odd counts, C172 retains one RPM ring with two equal-size opposite propeller markers.
gpu.checkerCorrection: Initial run failed only the new radius assertion, which compared canvas-relative centroids against UI-relative radii. Corrected for the existing 1.08 canvas overscan and reran; no production renderer changes were needed.

deterministicCoverage: 60/120 Hz accepted-frame limits with even22/36 and odd23/37 blade counts
30 FPS limit on a 120 Hz source
Jitter, long stalls, pending skipped frames and forced geometry redraws
Unwrapped full revolutions and clock/reference resets
Independent cadence and unchanged numeric DOM regression coverage
limitations: Individual evenly spaced blades may still alias or appear to reverse. The limit guards the two-hotspot orientation cue between submitted frames, not unobservable compositor-dropped presentation. GPU checks use synthetic timestamps and are correctness checks, not a frame-rate benchmark or device performance qualification.
